description: K₂NaInF₆ is (Cubic) Perovskite-derived structured and crystallizes in the cubic Fm̅3m space group. K is bonded to twelve equivalent F atoms to form KF₁₂ cuboctahedra that share corners with twelve equivalent KF₁₂ cuboctahedra, faces with six equivalent KF₁₂ cuboctahedra, faces with four equivalent NaF₆ octahedra, and faces with four equivalent InF₆ octahedra. All K-F bond lengths are 3.09 Å. Na is bonded to six equivalent F atoms to form NaF₆ octahedra that share corners with six equivalent InF₆ octahedra and faces with eight equivalent KF₁₂ cuboctahedra. The corner-sharing octahedra are not tilted. All Na-F bond lengths are 2.27 Å. In is bonded to six equivalent F atoms to form InF₆ octahedra that share corners with six equivalent NaF₆ octahedra and faces with eight equivalent KF₁₂ cuboctahedra. The corner-sharing octahedra are not tilted. All In-F bond lengths are 2.10 Å. F is bonded in a distorted linear geometry to four equivalent K, one Na, and one In atom.
